purpose: Prospective before-outcome architecture comparison responding to user priority; not replacement of historical Q1 gates
optimizer: Adam betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, zero weight decay
initialization: explicit per-arm source pin and deterministic seed; candidate begins at constant angular velocity
fit_sampler: PCG64 default_rng(SeedSequence([training_seed,fold_id])) uniform global fit origins with replacement, paired across all arms
candidate_schedule: 3 folds x 2 seeds x 4 arms = 24 fits; 5000 updates each; 100-update prefix may be resumed only from verified matching full-state checkpoint
validation: same frozen full user-disjoint origins and outcome safeguards as protocol v5; no old development/final signals
classical_reference: fit-only selection from competence-validated frozen candidate grid; limited to that grid
scientific_interpretation: Incremental full-recipe advantage only; no unproven reliability, novelty or effective-capacity attribution
required_prelaunch: exact model factory and input bindings
correct scoped provider, root authority and watchdog
fixed budget live ledger with 150s historical debit and 1800s reserve
full-path FP32 ONNX parity and CPU timing
separate root lock for new protocol before any outcomes
user_full_goal: All original Moonshot v2 thresholds, holdouts, independent evaluation, 10 seeds, lawful transfer and deployment remain unchanged
cost_policy: Stop before exceeding $20 total across compute, storage, transfer, fees and retries; live pricing and any spend-limit mechanism must be checked before rental. No actual spend or cloud access is authorized by this draft alone.
four_arm_rationale: Retain candidate, active order ablation, finite same-feature vector control and contemporaneous raw neural control; separately select classical comparator fairly within competent prespecified grid.
deferred_ablation: Single-exponential composition control is excluded from this four-arm screen; the screen cannot isolate or claim benefit specifically due to product composition. Add any future comparison only through separate prospectively locked plan and within the same $20 cap.
cost_savings_scope: 120000 versus 150000 planned updates is 20 percent fewer updates; actual time and dollars depend on individual model speeds, startup, data transfer, validation and failures and are not measured.
staged_execution: First run a bounded fit-only pilot to measure loss, throughput and cost without validation outcomes. Continue to the prespecified 24-fit comparison only after resource projection and gates. Do not modify arms or thresholds using observed evaluation outcomes.
final_evidence: If candidate progresses, report at least ten training seeds and a fair strongest comparator as required by the unchanged goal, without assuming all four arms need ten seeds. Preserve all frozen origins/holdouts, independent users, uncertainty, tails and licensed transfer gates. Feasibility under $20 remains unknown.
